capabilities: Download videos from yt-dlp-supported sites into the vault
Configure the vault download path and yt-dlp executable path
Set a default audio or video format
extras: Works only on the Windows Obsidian desktop app (not macOS, Linux, or mobile), and the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to download video or audio files from the web directly into the vault.

relations.evidence: An Obsidian plugin to download videos and audio directly into your vault, powered by yt-dlp.

summary: A Windows-only downloader that saves videos and audio from yt-dlp-supported sites directly into the vault as MP3, M4A, MP4 or WebM files.
